headline: [Editorial] Tax reform causes confusion in the jeonse/monthly rent market; supplementary measures urgently needed
summary: An editorial warns that the government's move from holding-based to residence-based real estate taxation is causing confusion in the jeonse and monthly rent market. It says rental supply may shrink as homeowners choose to live in their properties.
why: Jeonse is South Korea's distinctive lump-sum lease deposit system, and changes to property taxes can shift housing supply and rent levels, which affect household finances and the property market.
